evidence.fact: ReceiveBeginPlay applies GE_JingYe_LockHealth to the boss. Its AIScript_Rider uses BP_Monster_Horse_JingYe and the mounted ability pool; DropFromHorseOnHalfHealth is explicitly false because this boss has its own passive transition.
Infinite native effect overrides Health_Min with Health_Max * 0.2 and grants CharacterState.CanNotBeExecuted.
HealthThreshold is 0.6. The passive listens to Health changes and removal of CharacterState.AbilityState.JingYe.OnHorse.
NewHealth / Health_Max < HealthThreshold AND OnHorse causes one native activation of GA_JingYe_Ride_Exit.
The OnHorse tag removal delegate enters the ubergraph at 1211; statement 1260 removes GE_JingYe_LockHealth by source effect.
Native exit applies GE_JingYe_SecondPhase, grants GA_MonsterShield_Passive_JingYe, removes OnHorse, and clears the mounted AI combat-state-machine override.

interpretation: A single QA kill effect can reduce mounted JingYe to the native 20-percent floor and initiate dismount. The floor then becomes zero while current HP remains at 20 percent; more gameplay damage is still needed for victory. This observation alone is not an automatic-next regression.
limits: The mounted-to-ground transition is proven by native assets and bytecode.
The live final ground phase and complete victory remain unvalidated by this asset audit.
No health-floor removal, production edits, or forced completion were performed.
